jem_summary: Restore genuinely missing health with Essence to your owned companion while it is in Follow mode.

pages.title: Close and Cared For
pages.text: Restore genuinely missing health with Essence to your owned companion while it is in Follow mode.

pages.title: Close and Cared For
pages.text: Three Great Essences and an Empty Grail let the player immediately try filling a Chalice after genuinely caring for a companion.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use an empty main hand on your own companion until its message confirms Follow. Further interactions cycle its modes; Wander depends on configuration. After an ordinary fight use Small or Great Essence, without deliberately hurting the companion. Essences use their native hostile-loot/crafting

pages.title: Getting started
